# GitHub Copilot Instructions - ThinkingSeed Standard

When working in this repository:
1. Understand that architecture snapshots in `001_Seed/` represent the project's technical DNA and work-in-progress state, not an incomplete codebase.
2. When asked to generate or update a seed:
   - `/seed` creates `001_Seed/seed-[project-name].md` using the compact hybrid structure.
   - `/seedMaster` creates `001_Seed/seed-[project-name]-master.md` using the deep master structure.
3. Mark all claims with evidence levels: `[CONFIRMADO]`, `[INFERIDO]`, or `[FALTANTE]`.
4. Replace sensitive information (passwords, tokens, API keys) with `<REDACTED>`.
